notes:
Account summary:
- Media archive: national broadcaster-style content library; ingest pipeline includes legacy tapes -> transcripts + OCR; mix of transcripts, scripts, metadata, images; heavy multimodal plan later.
- Archive size: ~40M files (raw assets), ~12TB raw text; expected chunking -> ~100-140M text passages (avg 1-2KB/chunk).
- Primary problem: find-retrieve relevant passages from very long documents (multi-hour transcripts), reduce false positives, and preserve UX latency.
High-level requirements and targets:
- Workload: embeddings-based retrieval + cross-encoder reranker for precision on top results.
- Throughput: baseline 25 QPS sustained for search; spike up to 80 QPS during primetime.
- Latency SLO: target end-to-end 95th <= 500ms (ideal < 300ms). Retrieval stage target ~100-150ms; reranker stage budget ~150-250ms depending on model.
- Cost goal: total cost per query (retrieval + rerank) < $0.01 target; P0: demonstrate under $0.02.
Indexing / chunking notes from SE discussions:
- Prefer section-aware chunking: split on paragraph and speaker boundaries for transcripts, keep semantic segments (scene/act).
- Chunk size: 300-800 tokens typical; overlap ~100 tokens to preserve context for boundary queries.
- Dedup & normalization: normalize timestamps, remove boilerplate, keep canonical passage id + parent doc id; store checksum to avoid duplicate chunks.
- Metadata: episode_id, show, segment_timecode, speaker_list, language, OCR_confidence. Use metadata for cheap filter pre-filters.
Reranker tuning discussion:
- Proposed two-stage ranking: dense retrieval (HNSW/ANN) top-K=200 -> lightweight bi-encoder filter (cheap transformer) -> heavy cross-encoder rerank top-10.
- Cross-encoder model: currently evaluating mid-size cross-encoder (6-7B) vs distilled 1.3B for latency/cost tradeoffs.
- Experiments: tune K for recall vs reranker cost (K=100/200/500 tested). Initial SE recommendation: K=200, rerank_top=10, consider reranker fallback for low-confidence queries.
- Quality metrics: MRR@10, Recall@100, precision at 1 for live queries. Need labeled eval set (they will provide ~2k query-judgement pairs).
POC plan and scope:
- POC ingest slice: 2M representative transcripts (~1 month of production content) -> expected ~6M chunks.
- Build embedding index (quantized where possible), evaluate recall/latency and run reranker experiments (A/B with/without cross-encoder).
- Deliverables: perf/cost dashboard, latency percentiles, reranker precision lift, ops playbook for incremental indexing.
Operational notes / constraints:
- Data residency: must keep EU content in EU region (later phase). Initial POC in NA.
- Security: need full security questionnaire answered, want KMS integration and audit logs for all access.
- Incremental indexing cadence: daily delta ingestion with change-propagation; require tombstone/delete workflow for takedowns.
